schedule: before 8am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major updates wait for a tick in the Dependency Dashboard.
Roll up non-major devDependency bumps into one PR.
NestJS framework packages move together. NestJS 12 is held back by nestjs-zod peer deps — a major here needs manual review anyway (see docs/architecture.md / the version-ceiling note).
Zod and nestjs-zod version-lock each other (nestjs-zod pins a zod peer range) — always propose them as one change.
TypeORM and its Postgres drivers / Nest integration move together.
class-transformer and class-validator are used as a pair by Nest DTOs.
